But then it updated (assuming to collect more data on users bc it asks so many invasive questions now - also notifies you to constantly open the app for no reason) making it unusable after it finally asks you do you want the premium version. The app loads a black screen and then closes itself, not worth the redownload. Disappointing that prioritizing greed killed a perfectly fine app."
